quizzes.title: UAE: Trade, Energy and Community Links
quizzes.passage: The United Arab Emirates is one of India's most important partners in energy, trade and defence. In FY 2025-26, bilateral trade between India and the UAE stood at US$100 billion, and the UAE is a major supplier of crude oil, LNG and LPG to India. Recent talks have also covered crude storage at Fujairah under India's Overseas Strategic Reserve Framework. A Strategic Defence Partnership framework has been advanced, and a Ship Repair Cluster is planned at Vadinar through an MoU between Cochin Shipyard Limited and Drydocks World. The UAE's defence cooperation has three components, covering the military, the navy and the air force. Indian nationals form the largest expatriate community in the country. The Kafala system regulates the relationship between employers and migrant workers in several Gulf countries, and it has drawn attention to issues such as non-payment of wages. Artificial intelligence is another area of cooperation, with a term sheet signed for 8 Exaflop Super Computing Clusters. Investment cooperation includes plans by two funds to explore investments of up to US$1 billion in India's infrastructure sector. Both sides have also discussed a long-term LPG sale agreement between ADNOC Gas Limited and IOCL. Relations also include joint cultural initiatives, such as an MoU supporting a maritime heritage complex at Lothal in Gujarat. The UAE is also part of the India-Israel-UAE-USA grouping and BRICS, which the booklet lists under multilateral cooperation. Its cultural presence includes the UAE's first traditional Hindu stone temple, built by BAPS in Abu Dhabi. Both countries also discuss energy storage, with a proposal to store ADNOC crude oil in India's strategic reserves.

questions.q: Which currency is used in the UAE, according to the booklet?
questions.explanation: The booklet lists the Dirham as the UAE's currency.

questions.q: What does the word 'Kafala' mean in Arabic?
questions.explanation: The booklet says Kafala means 'sponsorship' in Arabic.

questions.q: Which two countries share land borders with the UAE?
questions.explanation: The booklet states that the UAE shares land borders with Oman and Saudi Arabia.

questions.q:
Assertion (A): Under the Kafala system, a foreign worker cannot change jobs or leave the country without the sponsor's permission.
Reason (R): The sponsor controls the worker's visa and legal status.
Which of the following is correct?
options: A is false but R is true
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
questions.explanation: The sponsor's control over visa and legal status is what makes permission necessary for changing jobs or leaving the country.

questions.q:
Match List I with List II:
I. Barakah Nuclear Power Plant   ->   A. UAE's highest civilian award
II. Order of Zayed   ->   B. Arab World's first nuclear power plant
III. BAPS Hindu Temple (Abu Dhabi)   ->   C. India's refuelling access at Al Dhafra
IV. Al Dhafra Air Base   ->   D. UAE's first traditional Hindu stone temple
Choose the correct match.
questions.explanation: Barakah is the Arab World's first nuclear plant, the Order of Zayed is the highest civilian award, BAPS is the first traditional Hindu stone temple, and Al Dhafra gives India refuelling access.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
I. The UAE's capital is Abu Dhabi.
II. The UAE has a maritime border with Qatar in the Persian Gulf.
III. The UAE shares a land border with Iran.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.explanation: The booklet gives Abu Dhabi as the capital and a maritime border with Qatar, while Iran is only a maritime neighbour.

questions.q:
Three statements are given below. How many of them are correct?
I. In 2022, India was the first country with which the UAE signed a CEPA.
II. The UAE accounted for 18% of India's remittance flows.
III. The UAE is a federal, elective monarchy of 5 emirates.
questions.explanation: Statements I and II match the booklet, while the UAE is a federation of 7 emirates, not 5.

quizzes.title: UAE: Quick Facts and Partnerships
quizzes.passage: India and the UAE share an economic relationship that runs from energy to investment. Trade between them reached US$100 billion in FY 2025-26, and the UAE is among India's largest sources of crude oil and gas. Discussions have covered a potential long-term LPG sale agreement between ADNOC Gas Limited and IOCL, while a strategic collaboration links IOCL with Abu Dhabi National Oil Company. Investment cooperation includes plans by two funds to explore investments of up to US$1 billion in India's infrastructure sector. A Strategic Defence Partnership framework has also been advanced, with a Ship Repair Cluster proposed at Vadinar. The UAE uses the Kafala system, which regulates relations between employers and migrant workers in several Gulf countries. Remittances from the Gulf form a significant link between the two economies. Artificial intelligence cooperation is also growing, with a term sheet for 8 Exaflop Super Computing Clusters under India's AI Mission. Maritime and cultural cooperation continues as well, including an MoU for a maritime heritage complex at Lothal, in Gujarat.

questions.q: What is the currency of the UAE? (one word)
questions.explanation: The booklet lists the Dirham as the UAE's currency.

questions.q: In 2022, India became the first country with which the UAE signed which agreement? (give the short form)
questions.explanation: The booklet says the UAE signed a CEPA with India first in 2022.

questions.q: What percentage of India's remittance flows did the UAE account for? (number only)
questions.explanation: The booklet states the UAE accounted for 18% of India's remittance flows.

questions.q: Which community forms the largest expatriate community within the UAE? (one word)
questions.explanation: The booklet states that Indian nationals form the largest expatriate community in the UAE.

questions.q: In which year was the UAE's highest civilian award, the Order of Zayed, awarded? (year)
questions.explanation: The booklet says the Order of Zayed was awarded in 2019.

questions.q: Which air base in the UAE gives India access for refuelling? (name the base)
questions.explanation: The booklet lists India's access to the UAE's Al Dhafra Air Base for refuelling.

questions.q: What is the name of the Arab World's first nuclear power plant? (name)
questions.explanation: The booklet describes the Barakah Nuclear Power Plant as the Arab World's first nuclear power plant.

quizzes.title: Italy and Netherlands: Partnerships and Heritage
quizzes.passage: Italy and India have built a broad relationship that now covers trade, technology, culture and heritage. The two countries have a joint action plan for 2025 to 2029 that covers defence, the economy, connectivity, science and innovation. Italy has also joined the International Solar Alliance and the Global Biofuel Alliance, and both countries have backed the India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor (IMEEC). Italy is also part of the India-Italy-Japan trilateral, which focuses on Indo-Pacific security, stability and multilateral cooperation. Italy is an important trading partner for India within the European Union, and its Indian diaspora is the largest in the bloc. The Netherlands is another key partner, serving as a gateway to Europe for Indian business and ranking among the top sources of foreign direct investment. Cooperation with the Netherlands includes water management, climate resilience and sustainable infrastructure. Universities in the Netherlands have partnered with IIT Delhi and IISc for semiconductor research, talent development and advanced technology. Cultural diplomacy has also played a role, as ancient copper plates were returned to India by a Dutch university. Leiden University is among the institutions that returned heritage objects to India. Together, these exchanges show how India's partnerships in Europe combine economic, scientific and cultural goals.

questions.q: What did India and Italy upgrade their bilateral relations to?
questions.explanation: The booklet says India and Italy upgraded bilateral relations to a Special Strategic Partnership.

questions.q: Which programme connects Indian students studying in Italy with internships, skill development and corporate employment?
questions.explanation: The booklet names this programme 'Italy Calls India'.

questions.q: In which city is the headquarters of the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) located?
questions.explanation: The booklet states that the FAO's headquarters is in Rome, Italy.

questions.q:

Which of the following is correct?
options: A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
questions.explanation: The booklet says the year is declared to commemorate 80 years of diplomatic relations, which explains the declaration.

questions.q:
Match List I with List II:
I. Afsluitdijk Dam   ->   A. Gulf of Khambhat
II. Kalpasar Project   ->   B. Dholera (Gujarat)
III. Tata Electronics-ASML MoU   ->   C. Freshwater IJsselmeer Lake

Choose the correct match.
questions.explanation: Afsluitdijk transformed the Zuiderzee into IJsselmeer, Kalpasar lies across the Gulf of Khambhat, Tata-ASML supports Dholera, and IMEEC is an Asia-Europe corridor.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
I. The FAO was founded on 16 October 1945.
II. The capital of the Netherlands is Amsterdam.
III. The Afsluitdijk Dam is 42 km long.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.explanation: The FAO was founded in 1945 and Amsterdam is the Netherlands' capital, while the Afsluitdijk is 32 km long, not 42.

questions.q:

II. The collection consists of 21 large and 3 smaller copper sheets.

questions.explanation: Statements I and II match the booklet, while the inscriptions are in both Tamil and Sanskrit.

quizzes.title: Italy and Netherlands: Quick Facts
quizzes.passage: Italy and India have raised their relationship to a higher level, with cooperation across trade, defence, science and culture. Both countries back a corridor-linked initiative that seeks to improve trade connectivity, logistics, energy and digital links between Asia and Europe. Italy has also joined the International Solar Alliance and the Global Biofuel Alliance. Its programme for Indian students links them with internships, skill development and corporate employment. Italy is an important trading partner for India within the European Union. The Netherlands is a gateway to Europe for India and a significant source of investment. Cooperation with the Netherlands covers semiconductors, water management, climate resilience and sustainable infrastructure. Dutch universities have partnered with Indian institutions for semiconductor research and talent development. Heritage links are also part of the relationship, since a Dutch university returned ancient copper plates to India. Cooperation in water management also draws on Dutch experience with a large dam that turned a saltwater inlet into a freshwater lake, and India has its own proposal for a large freshwater storage project. The Netherlands also ranks among India's top sources of foreign direct investment, and Italy is also part of the India-Italy-Japan trilateral, which focuses on Indo-Pacific security and stability.

questions.q: What partnership level did India and Italy upgrade their bilateral relations to? (name the partnership)
questions.explanation: The booklet says India and Italy upgraded bilateral relations to a Special Strategic Partnership.

questions.q: What bilateral trade value, in EUR billion, did India and Italy commit to reach by 2029? (number only)
questions.explanation: The booklet states that both countries committed to raising bilateral trade to EUR 20 billion by 2029.

questions.q: Which year has been declared the Year of Culture and Tourism between India and Italy? (year)
questions.explanation: The booklet declares 2027 as the Year of Culture and Tourism between India and Italy.

questions.q: How many years of diplomatic relations does the 2027 Year of Culture and Tourism commemorate? (number of years)
questions.explanation: The booklet says the year commemorates 80 years of diplomatic relations.

questions.q: In which year was the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO), a UN specialised agency, founded? (year)
questions.explanation: The booklet states that the FAO was founded on 16 October 1945.

questions.q: Which company signed an MoU with Tata Electronics to support India's semiconductor plant in Dholera, Gujarat? (name the company)
questions.explanation: The booklet records an MoU between Tata Electronics and ASML supporting the Dholera semiconductor plant.

questions.q: In which Indian state is the proposed Kalpasar Project located? (name the state)
questions.explanation: The booklet describes the Kalpasar Project as a proposed dam in Gujarat.
